name: Murasame
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:curse)(Tag:poison)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "One-Cut Killer", Murasame is a durable sharp sword Teigu that kills any living being with even a shallow cut via a heart-seeking poisonous curse, though stronger targets resist slightly. Experiencing great loss unlocks its trump card, briefly massively boosting speed and strength. As this item is a Teigu, it can only be used by compatible true killers who find it beautiful.
